answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 149840 Country: India Title: Dua to recite for protection from miscarriage. Question: Dua to recite for protection from miscarriage. Answer ID: 149840 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 770/690/SN=7/1438) If the below mentioned verse is written on some paper and tied with the stomach [of the pregnant woman], then in-shaAllah, the fetus shall remain safe. (Bahishti Zewar, vol. 9) وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلاَّ بِاللّهِ وَلاَ تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ إِنَّ اللّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَواْ وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ. Also the woman should read the following dua after each fardh salah: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاء [آل عمران : 38] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
